name: Afghanistan (1928–1929)
description: A vertical tricolor of black, red and green charged with a golden wreathed emblem of a snow-capped mountain and rising sun.
history: King Amanullah's modernizing flag of 1928, with the mountain-and-sunrise emblem inspired by his European tour; it fell with him in the 1929 rebellion. It fixed black-red-green as Afghanistan's lasting colours.

features.role: mountain, rising sun and wheat wreath
